print(len(rows))
uri_ts={}
for r in rows:
    uri_ts[r['point_uri']]=r['timeseries_id']
# zone electric power sensors
zones=['Zone_F1_Z01','Zone_F2_Z01','Zone_F2_Z02','Zone_F2_Z03','Zone_F2_Z04','Zone_F2_Z05','Zone_F2_Z06','Zone_F2_Z07','Zone_F2_Z08','Zone_F2_Z09','Zone_F3_Z01','Zone_F3_Z02','Zone_F3_Z03','Zone_F3_Z04','Zone_F3_Z05','Zone_F4_Z01','Zone_F4_Z02','Zone_F4_Z03','Zone_F4_Z04','Zone_F4_Z05']
base="http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#"
for z in zones:
    uri=base+z+"_Electric_Power_Sensor"
    print(z, uri_ts.get(uri))

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(CATALOG_CSV)))
uri_ts={}
ts_unit={}
for r in rows:
    uri_ts[r['point_uri']]=r['timeseries_id']
    ts_unit[r['timeseries_id']]=r['unit']

zones=['Zone_F1_Z01','Zone_F2_Z01','Zone_F2_Z02','Zone_F2_Z03','Zone_F2_Z04','Zone_F2_Z05','Zone_F2_Z06','Zone_F2_Z07','Zone_F2_Z08','Zone_F2_Z09','Zone_F3_Z01','Zone_F3_Z02','Zone_F3_Z03','Zone_F3_Z04','Zone_F3_Z05','Zone_F4_Z01','Zone_F4_Z02','Zone_F4_Z03','Zone_F4_Z04','Zone_F4_Z05']
base="http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#"
zone_ids=[uri_ts[base+z+"_Electric_Power_Sensor"] for z in zones]
build_id=uri_ts[base+"ElectricMeter"]
print("build_unit", ts_unit[build_id])
print("sample zone unit", ts_unit[zone_ids[0]])

vals=list(csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)))
day="2018-04-11"
build_sum=0.0
zone_sum=0.0
zone_count=0
for tsid in zone_ids:
    s=0.0
    for v in vals:
        if v['timeseries_id']==tsid and v['timestamp'].startswith(day):
            s+=float(v['value'])
    zone_sum+=s
build_for_day=0.0
for v in vals:
    if v['timeseries_id']==build_id and v['timestamp'].startswith(day):
        build_for_day+=float(v['value'])
print("zone_total_W", zone_sum)
print("building_total_J", build_for_day)
# zone values are watts (hourly) -> energy Wh. Building values in J over the hour.
# Wh -> J: *3600
print("fraction", zone_sum*3600/build_for_day)
